title: What's New: Cross-Environment Consolidations (2023 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Setting up business units for cross-environment

features.name: Cross-environment consolidation
features.description: Ability to consolidate financial data from business units located in different environments, not just the same environment. Uses API endpoints to communicate across environments instead of requiring file export/import.
caveats: Authentication required with user in other company
Company must be toggled as subsidiary to enable data extraction

features.name: Consolidation wizard
features.description: New action-based wizard for running consolidations that allows users to select starting date, ending date, consolidation document number, and presents a list of business units to consolidate with optional authentication.
caveats: Previous report-based approach still exists and won't be deprecated
Procedures for running consolidation are internal and not exposed

features.name: API endpoint configuration for subsidiaries
features.description: Business units can now be set up with an API type endpoint, allowing cross-environment consolidation. The endpoint can be copied from the consolidation setup page in the subsidiary company.
caveats: Requires authentication with user credentials in the other company
Must select which company in the remote environment to set up

features.name: Business unit subsidiary toggle
features.description: Companies can be toggled as subsidiaries to enable data extraction for consolidation. This toggle controls whether data can be imported from that company.
caveats: Must be enabled before consolidation setup can proceed
Can be disabled at any time to prevent data extraction

features.name: Consolidation setup page endpoint
features.description: The consolidation setup page displays an environment endpoint that can be copied and used when configuring business units for cross-environment consolidation.

features.name: Minority interest handling in consolidation
features.description: The consolidation feature handles minority interest accounting by allowing configuration of consolidation percentages less than 100 percent, automatically posting offsetting entries for minority interest.

features.name: Currency mapping in consolidation
features.description: Allows mapping different currencies between subsidiaries and the holding company. Users can choose to use subsidiary currency rates or holding company rates, and can opt for additional reporting currency exchange rates.

features.name: Chart of accounts mapping in consolidation
features.description: Subsidiaries can have different chart of accounts structures that are mapped to the consolidation company's chart of accounts.

features.name: Trial balance for consolidation
features.description: Users can run a trial balance report for consolidation to verify data before consolidating.

features.name: Financial reporting with consolidation data
features.description: Financial reports can be created and used to view consolidated data across business units, showing combined business overview.
